intent: A checkbox with checked / unchecked / mixed states; renders on the light inspector or a dark canvas surface (ghost).
use_when: A toggleable option in a form or list.
You need an indeterminate (mixed) parent state.
dont_use_when: A single prominent on/off setting — a Switch reads better.

tokens.note: Fully token-bound: the checked fill and border, and the dark checked surface (--color-bg-overlay), all resolve to DS tokens.

a11y.label: ariaLabel when the visible label is rendered by the owning row.
